To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we have characterized β-domains of C-terminal fragments of TAR DNA-binding protein (TDP-42) using scanning tunneling microscope (STM) to investigate the structural basis of the cytotoxicity and fibril formation of TDP-42 in amyotrophic lateral sclerois (ALS) and frontotemporal degeneration (FTD).
the β-domains in TDP-43 C-terminal fragments are characterized by STM, which reveals a higher tendency in β-sheet formation of the A31T(p)-TDP-43-containing fragment as compared to wild-type TDP43.
we have identified the β-domains in TDP-43 and its mutants by STM and the β-domains are related to the cytotoxicity and the fibril formation of TDP- 43.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a better understanding of the structural mechanism of the TDP-43 mutation-related neurodegenerative disease.
the identification of structural changes in β-domain of TDP-343 in the presence of the A315E and A315T mutations.
the characterization of β-domain in the C-terminal fragment of TDP- 43 using STM.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the A315T mutation is the most important mutation in the TDP-43 proteinopathy, and the phosphorylation of S409/410 is a secondary factor that accelerates the aggregation of TDP-343 protein.
the A315E mutant has the most β-domains, A315T(p), the second most β-domain, A315T the least β-domains.
the core region of the beta-sheet of the C-terminal fragments is longer in A315T(p), followed by A315T, Wt, and A315E.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the core regions of the beta-sheet of TDP-343 are 6 amino acids long and the length of the core regions for the beta-sheet of A315T and WT is the same.
the core region of β-domains is a key structural determinant of TDP- 43 proteinopathy.

our study provides a supportive evidence for the higher tendency in beta-sheets formation of A315(p) containing TPD-43 fragment, which may explain the higher cytotoxic and accelerated fibril-forming properties of the A315(p) mutant TPD-43 as compared to Wt TDP43.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the core length of the β-domain is a critical factor that determines the cytotoxicity of TDP-42 fragments.
the A315T mutation and phosphorylation of TDP- 43 can affect the core regions of β-domains and the formation of β-sheets.
the β-domains of TDP- 43 are the key structural components for the formation of the β-sheets, which are the main structural components of the fibrils of TDP-4 3.
